args.goal: Per products/research/next-idea-scan.json (broken-link verdict PURSUE_IF: khadinakbar has 53 users_30d at USD 0.001 per link; the others have 0-6), build products/actors/link-checker offline. Input: a supplied list of public http(s) URLs (no crawling), max 1000. Output: one stable JSON row per URL (url, final_url, status_code, redirect_count, ok, error_code, error, elapsed_ms). Reuse the bounded-read, timeout and error-row code from products/actors/rss-reader/src/core.py, with packaging like rss-reader and an EN/FR README with the AI disclosure. Use HEAD with a GET fallback, a per-host concurrency of 1, and a User-Agent that identifies the Actor. Test only against a local 127.0.0.1 server (200, 301 chain, 404, 500, timeout, redirect loop, invalid scheme) and save core-test-results.json from real execution. Proposed events: link-checked 800 micro-USD and apify-actor-start 50 micro-USD, labeled as proposed. Do not probe credentials. Complete with a lesson only after reading the results.

description: RSS-ACTOR-BUILD is complete. products/actors/rss-reader has a Python stdlib parser, Apify packaging, an EN/FR README with the AI disclosure, and llms.txt. It passed 22 of 22 real offline tests (core-test-results.json). These covered the saved github.blog feed (10 items), Atom, RSS 1.0/2.0, malformed and empty documents, refusal of XXE and billion-laughs DTDs (including UTF-16), and loopback tests for timeouts, bounded reads and HTTP 404. Two bugs were found and fixed: the byte-level DOCTYPE check rejected the real GitHub feed, and  -style entities caused parse errors. The Apify wrapper has only been byte-compiled, and nothing is listed. The NO-APIFY-ACCESS blocker now says rss-reader is the Actor to build first. No revenue, users or funding exist. Queued next: an rss-reader launch mission, store copy for ACQUISITION, and an offline URL-list link checker build that reuses the fetch code.
